components.name: Tula Check-in Wallet
components.description: Open-source Tula web wallet for SMART Health Check-in. Holds synthetic patient Dylan Meyer. Health data only; insurance cards come back unavailable.
components.testPatient: Dylan Meyer (synthetic, 51). Essential hypertension, prediabetes, hyperlipidemia. Lisinopril 10 mg. Penicillin allergy. Seasonal influenza, COVID-19, and Tdap. No insurance card.
components.notes: Insurance items are returned unavailable (Tula policy: health data only). Opened directly, the page is a landing page. A Verifier must window.open it. Local verifier at demo.html.
